exact_reuse: Each profile intentionally covers seven zones and three scenarios; rooftop/utility share physical solar cache, but their frozen weights differ.

scaling_clipping.AtLite_normalization: convert.py:259-267 divides aggregated power by installed layout capacity; constant correction in layout cancels in this ratio, so it is not a second output correction.
scaling_clipping.empirical_resource_layout: Mean resource CF * cell area * capacity density is spatial weighting only; no installed MEM capacity is transferred.
scaling_clipping.lower_threshold_stage: temporal_2019.py:575; per bus after resource correction, before national weighting
scaling_clipping.exact_lower_threshold_changed_counts: UNKNOWN_PRE_THRESHOLD_VALUES_NOT_SAVED; post-threshold zero counts supplied per upstream bus
scaling_clipping.missing_time_filling: No VRE temporal interpolation/forward-fill. AtLite per-unit aggregation fillna(0) only for zero-capacity divisions; selected IT2/IT4 buses have positive layout capacity and complete finite cache profiles.
scaling_clipping.sub_one_maxima: Solar maxima reflect fixed panel/orientation and spatial averaging. Offshore 0.8855 is an explicit resource correction, not a hidden post-hoc cap; national maxima are further reduced by IT2/IT4 averaging.

code_provenance: src/mem_model/stage_a/temporal_2019.py:779-815 (spatial weighted aggregation and Base capacity weights)
src/mem_model/network.py:102-142 (frozen p_nom and unscaled p_max_pu pivot)
limitations: No pre-threshold AtLite output was saved: the precise count of positive values clipped below 0.01 is not identifiable from post-threshold zeros. Post-threshold zero counts are disclosed; no recomputation was performed.
This audit verifies existing cache-to-source-to-runtime-to-network lineage, not independent weather or turbine validation. Existing 2019 weather and accepted spatial assumptions were not reopened.

Zonal resource diversity is not represented: all seven zones deliberately reuse the accepted national technology profile; this is existing architecture, not an accidental join or a new audit assumption.
Availability CF is specific to the accepted resource conversion, spatial weighting and correction/threshold choices as well as weather year; it is not a raw-wind-speed metric.
